opening.argument: The video directs viewers to pay $99 for BitClub membership in Bitcoin, with a payment page displaying the amount and receiving address. It then instructs viewers to buy mining pools costing hundreds or thousands of dollars, connecting those purchases to future Bitcoin mining and an invitation to earn. These concrete payment instructions and earning claims establish the scam pitch: pay for membership, then purchase mining capacity presented as a route to earnings. The evidence does not establish that payment was completed, that anyone suffered a loss, or that the service performed as described.
